parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/PlayerControllerBehaviorTests.swift`. Although the pipeline reports a Jaccard similarity of ~0.78, the two methods have semantically distinct purposes: `multipleStopCallsAreIdempotent` (line 132) verifies idempotency of repeated stop calls, while `playAfterStopWorks` (line 234) verifies that playback can resume after a stop — these are intentionally separate behavioral assertions. Structural similarity in test bodies (e.g., shared setup/teardown boilerplate or assertion patterns) is expected and desirable in a well-organised test suite and does not warrant consolidation.
